description: A professional conference organizer needs to configure intelligent branching logic on the post-event attendee feedback survey 'Annual Tech Summit 2024 — Attendee Feedback'. The survey has already been built with questions in three groups but currently shows all questions to all respondents regardless of their answers. Your task is to add conditional display logic (using LimeSurvey's Expression Manager) so the survey adapts to respondents' answers. Log in at http://localhost/index.php/admin with admin/Admin123!. Apply the following logic: (1) The question group 'Session Feedback' (containing questions about specific sessions attended) should only display if the respondent answered 'Yes' to question ATTENDED_SESSIONS ('Did you attend any breakout sessions?'). (2) The question 'IMPROVE_COMMENTS' ('What specific improvements would you suggest?') should only display if the respondent gave an overall satisfaction rating of 6 or below on question OVERALL_RATING. (3) Configure the survey's end redirect URL to 'http://techsummit.example.com/thank-you' so respondents are taken to the conference website after completing the survey.

metadata.instrument_source: Professional conference post-event evaluation (PCMA/MPI best practices)
